page.notes: Arabic and Hebrew passages were read from a small, low-resolution scan. The Arabic in the margins and the Arabic/Hebrew-script line after "quia" and "Maimonides" are approximate; check them against the original. The word after "seu" (Arabic) and the Arabic line before "Religionum" are illegible. The Hebrew-script line "כאנה מלה" and "אעמת אלארץ" are copied as they appear; the first Arabic line in the margin after "Sacella" was transcribed roughly. "effentiæ" and "relurrectionem" are printed as shown; the long s may be read as f, and "relurrectionem" is probably a printing error for "resurrectionem". Margin note placement is approximate, and the note markers in the text (*) are printed signs.
